name: Gyarados
description: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Splash
moves.description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

moves.name: Twister
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the target.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target with viciously sharp fangs to inflict damage.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that its future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam.
